title: We cannot control claude.ai's chat context, so we should not pretend: tooling supports the user, it doesn't work around them (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Take a look at this essay in musrs. I wrote this with claude.ai.  Much of he conversation took place in claude's own chat. We cannot control that context. So we should not pretend. 

We create the tooling to support the user, but we're not workign around the user.
